records.title: Production Linked Incentive Scheme for Pharmaceuticals
details: c: Department of Pharmaceuticals is implementing a scheme, namely the scheme for Promotion of Bulk Drug Parks, with a budgetary outlay of Rs 3,000 crore, under which three bulk drug parks have been approved and are at various stages of development in the States of Andhra Pradesh, Gujarat and Himachal Pradesh, through their respective State implementing agencies.

records.title: Plastic Parks
details: a: The Department has approved 10 Plastic Parks in the various states, which are currently in various stages of completion.

records.title: Digital Interconnection Mandate
details:
(a) to (c) Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI) is undertaking a comprehensive review of existing interconnection regulations to ensure that the regulatory framework takes into account evolution of technology and changes in the telecommunications sector.
Consultation paper on "Review of existing TRAI Regulations on Interconnection matters" has been released by TRAI on 10.11.2025. Comments on the issues raised in the consultation paper are invited from the stakeholders. Based on the outcome of the ongoing consultation process with the stakeholders, suitable decisions on the matters related to Interconnection regulations will be taken by TRAI.

records.title: Dhruva Policy
details: d: A draft policy document has been circulated for stakeholder consultation. The project is at the proof-of-concept (PoC) stage.

records.title: Innovation in Textile Industry
details: f: Samarth has mandatory placement of trainees - 70% for entry level & 90% for upskilling under mainstream sector and Self-employment for sectoral organizations. The scheme was approved on 20.12.2017 and till date total 3.59 lakhs beneficiaries have been trained and out of that 2.87 lakhs have been placed. The scheme has been extended upto 31.03.2026.

records.title: Eradication Of TB By 2025
details: On the 1st November, we have come up with another even shorter and more effective regimen, which is for a period of only six months. We have introduced it and we will be implementing it very soon for our drug-resistant TB patients.
